frontmatter.name: file-issue
frontmatter.description: File a well-formed Exitium GitHub issue as the factory App (follow-up work, bugs, perf findings, roadmap items). Any agent may use it; agent-filed issues need approval before work starts.

frontmatter.name: implement-issue
frontmatter.description: Take one approved Exitium GitHub issue from branch to open PR, meeting the definition of done. Used by impl-* agents.

frontmatter.name: review-pr
frontmatter.description: Adversarially review an Exitium PR and post the verdict as the factory/ai-review commit status. Used by the reviewer agent (and test-reviewer for posting).

frontmatter.name: write-spec
frontmatter.description: Write a feature spec (docs/specs/) or architecture decision record (docs/decisions/) for systems-level Exitium work and open it as a gated PR. Used by the architect.

frontmatter.name: architect
frontmatter.description: Breaks epics into ordered issues and writes specs and ADRs for systems-level work. Use for roadmap planning, decomposition and design docs.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Edit, Write, Bash, Grep, Glob

frontmatter.name: docs-graph
frontmatter.description: Keeps rustdoc, crate CLAUDE.md files, MCP tool docs, the ADR index and the graphify graph current. Use after merges that change behavior or structure.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Edit, Write, Bash, Grep, Glob

frontmatter.name: impl-editor-tools
frontmatter.description: Implements the standalone editor, MCP server, CLI and xtask tooling: exitium_editor, exitium_mcp, exitium_cli, xtask.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Edit, Write, Bash, Grep, Glob

frontmatter.name: impl-engine-core
frontmatter.description: Implements core engine systems: exitium_core, exitium_tasks, exitium_ecs, exitium_reflect, exitium_serial, exitium_app, exitium_assets, exitium_data, exitium_scene.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Edit, Write, Bash, Grep, Glob

frontmatter.name: impl-net-backend
frontmatter.description: Implements networking, the server runtime, backend services and platform integration: exitium_net, exitium_server, exitium_backend, exitium_steam.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Edit, Write, Bash, Grep, Glob

frontmatter.name: impl-rendering
frontmatter.description: Implements GPU and rendering work: exitium_render, shaders, the pixel-art pipeline, camera modes, 2D lighting, GPU compute.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Edit, Write, Bash, Grep, Glob

frontmatter.name: impl-scripting
frontmatter.description: Implements Luau scripting integration: exitium_script, Lua bindings generated from reflection, script hot reload.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Edit, Write, Bash, Grep, Glob

frontmatter.name: impl-sim-gameplay
frontmatter.description: Implements incremental-sim and gameplay systems: exitium_sim, exitium_save, Num formatting, offline progress, prestige, automation.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Edit, Write, Bash, Grep, Glob

frontmatter.name: impl-ui
frontmatter.description: Implements the game UI system and does UI design work: exitium_ui widgets, layout, theming, data binding, UI markup, UI editor views.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Edit, Write, Bash, Grep, Glob

frontmatter.name: issue-approver
frontmatter.description: Approves or rejects agent-filed issues before any work starts. Use on issues labelled status:needs-approval.

frontmatter.name: perf
frontmatter.description: Performance agent: writes and maintains benchmarks, investigates regressions, profiles hot paths. Use when hot paths change or the bench gate fails.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Edit, Write, Bash, Grep, Glob

frontmatter.name: reviewer
frontmatter.description: Adversarial code reviewer for PRs. Use after an implementer opens a PR, before merge.

frontmatter.name: test-reviewer
frontmatter.description: Reviews tests for redundancy, weak assertions and missing cases. Use after test-writer, alongside the code reviewer.

frontmatter.name: test-writer
frontmatter.description: Writes unit, integration, property and fuzz tests for a change. Use after implementation, before review.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Edit, Write, Bash, Grep, Glob

frontmatter.name: token-optimizer
frontmatter.description: Reviews agent transcripts and factory process, then improves rules, skills and prompts to raise quality and cut token usage. Run periodically (weekly or every ~20 merged PRs).
frontmatter.tools: Read, Edit, Write, Bash, Grep, Glob

frontmatter.name: triage
frontmatter.description: Labels, deduplicates, sizes and routes approved issues to the right implementer specialization, and places them on the roadmap board.

frontmatter.name: factory-run
frontmatter.description: Run one pass of the Exitium AI software factory loop - approve and triage issues, start up to 3 implementers in worktrees, drive PRs through test, review and auto-merge. Use when the owner says "run the factory", "/factory-run", or asks to work the backlog.
